storyCards.headline: Mo Money Mo Problems: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
The Notorious B.i.g's "Mo Money Mo Problems" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 30 weeks on the chart.

Mo Money Mo Problems was released in 1997.

"Mo Money Mo Problems" by The Notorious B.i.g.

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
